name: Ash Logs
note: Pieces of wood collected from branches, saplings and Ash trees.

name: Oak Logs
note: Sturdy oak logs obtained by chopping oak trees with a bronze axe or better, used for crafting equipment and furniture.

name: Willow Logs
note: Obtained by chopping willow trees with an iron logging axe or better; a highly efficient fuel for smelting advanced metals.

name: Maple Logs
note: Obtained by chopping maple trees with a mithril logging axe or better; used for equipment, staves, bows and fishing rods.

name: Yew Logs
note: A durable, heat-resistant wood obtained by chopping yew trees with an adamant logging axe or better.

name: Magic Logs
note: Magic logs are obtained by chopping down Magic Trees with a Rune Logging Axe or better.

name: Ash Plank
note: A basic building material created by processing ash logs at a sawmill, yielding 2 planks per log.

name: Oak Plank
note: A lumber resource created by processing oak logs at a sawmill, primarily used in construction.

name: Yew Plank
note: A milled timber resource created by processing yew logs at a sawmill, used in construction and artisan crafting.

name: Blightwood
note: A woodcutting resource chopped from the pale blightwood root on larger trees in Bloodblight Swamp.

name: Bloodwood Sap
note: A harvested resource obtained by logging bloodwood trees in the Bloodblight Swamp, used in crafting the challenge horn during the Dragon Slayer quest.

name: Hollow Bark
note: A resource obtained from dead trees in Fellhollow, used in crafting magical armour and weapons through the Artisan skill.

name: Thorny Irit Root
note: A woodcutting resource in Fellhollow that yields Irit plants and seeds when harvested with a steel logging axe, respawning every three days.

name: Anima-Infused Bark
note: Tree bark infused with magical energy, found near anima and crystal trees in the Fractured Plains and used to create wild anima.

name: Rune Essence
note: A mysterious porous rock used as a base for powerful runes, gathered from rocks near geysers in Ashenfall.

name: Air Rune
note: Craftable at level 1 Runecrafting using Rune Essence; used as ammunition for magic weapons or spell components.

name: Astral Rune
note: Crafted at level 3 Runecrafting; used in spells for enchanting weapons, resource gathering, and accessing chests.

name: Water Rune
note: A symbol of flowing waters, essential for water-based magic; crafted via Runecrafting at level 11.

name: Earth Rune
note: A symbol of the earth's might, essential for earth-based magic; crafted at level 15 Runecrafting.

name: Fire Rune
note: A symbol of blazing heat, essential for fire-based magic; crafted at level 25 Runecrafting.

name: Nature Rune
note: Used for casting transmutation spells; craftable at level 38 Runecrafting.

name: Law Rune
note: Crafted at level 50 Runecrafting; needed for teleporting with lodestones.

name: Redberry Seeds
note: Brynmoor-type farming seeds used to grow redberries, yielding 5 Farming experience when planted.

name: Cabbage Seeds
note: Brynmoor crop seeds used in Farming to grow cabbages, yielding 5 experience when planted.

name: Potato Seeds
note: Used in Farming to grow potatoes, best planted in ash farming plots.

name: Flax Seeds
note: Brynmoor-type farming seeds used to grow flax plants, yielding 5 experience per planting.

name: Wheat Seeds
note: Brynmoor crops used in Farming that yield 5 experience when planted in farming plots.

name: Harralander Seeds
note: Brynmoor herb seeds used in Farming to grow harralander plants.

name: Marentill Seeds
note: Brynmoor herb seeds for farming plots, obtainable from Marrentil plants with a 15% chance.

name: Ash Tree Seed
note: A farming seed players can plant to grow ash trees.

name: Dwellberry Seeds
note: A Ghornfell crop seed that players cultivate through the Farming skill.

name: Onion Seeds
note: Ghornfell farming seeds obtained from harvesting wild onion plants.

name: Tomato Seeds
note: A Ghornfell crop seed used in the Farming skill to cultivate tomatoes.

name: Kwuarm Seeds
note: Ghornfell herb seeds that grow into kwuarm.

name: Swamp Weed Seeds
note: A Ghornfell seed used in Farming to grow swamp weed, yielding 5 experience when planted.

name: Snapdragon Seeds
note: Ghornfell herb seeds used in Farming that grow into medicinal herbs for Herblore.

name: Toadflax Seeds
note: Ghornfell herb seeds used in Farming, obtainable by harvesting wild toadflax plants with a 15% drop rate.

name: Oak Tree Seed
note: A Farming item used to grow oak trees, obtainable from oak trees at a 5% drop rate.

name: Avantoe Seeds
note: Fellhollow herb seeds used in Farming to grow avantoe plants, yielding 5 experience when planted.

name: Cadavaberry Seeds
note: Seeds used in Farming, best planted in Fellhollow plots and obtained from harvesting cadavaberry bushes.

name: Pumpkin Seeds
note: Fellhollow-type farming seeds that yield 5 Farming experience when planted.

name: Watermelon Seeds
note: Fellhollow crop seeds used in Farming to grow watermelon plants, best planted in willow farming plots.

name: Corpse Cotton Seeds
note: Farming seeds that grow corpse cotton plants, best planted in Fellhollow plots.

name: Irit Seeds
note: Fellhollow herb seeds used in the Farming skill to grow irit herbs in farming plots.

name: Willow Tree Seed
note: A farming seed used to grow willow trees.

name: Maple Tree Seed
note: A seed used with the Farming skill to cultivate maple trees.

name: Desert Weed Seeds
note: Umbral Sand seeds used in Farming to grow Desert Weed, best planted in yew farming plots.

name: Bunny Cactus Seeds
note: An Umbral Sand farming seed used to grow Bunny Cactus plants.

name: Pipe Cactus Seeds
note: An Umbral Sands seed used in Farming to grow Pipe Cactus plants, best planted in yew farming plots.

name: Barrel Cactus Seeds
note: An Umbral Sands seed used in Farming to grow barrel cacti, best planted in yew farming plots.

name: Yew Tree Seed
note: A farming seed used to cultivate yew trees, obtainable from yew trees with a 1 in 20 drop rate.

name: Magic Tree Seed
note: An unreleased farming seed that exists in game files but is not intended to be accessible in game.

name: Redberries
note: A consumable food item providing 5 sustenance that can be gathered from bushes or farmed.

name: Cabbage
note: A power level 2 raw ingredient that can be cooked starting at Cooking level 12.

name: Potato
note: A power level 2 raw ingredient that can be cooked into baked potato at Cooking level 12 or burnt potato at level 27.

name: Flax
note: A harvested resource used for crafting linen and bowstrings.

name: Wheat
note: A sheaf of wheat; a power level 2 raw ingredient obtainable through farming.

name: Harralander
note: A fragrant herb used in restorative potions, harvested from plants in the Whispering Swamp.

name: Marrentil
note: A bitter tasting herb used in resistance potions, harvested from plants or purchased from merchants.

name: Dwellberries
note: Blue berries providing 10 sustenance that can be cooked, farmed, or used in various recipes.

name: Onion
note: A power level 3 raw ingredient that can be cooked into fried onions starting at Cooking level 27.

name: Tomato
note: A power level 2 raw ingredient that can be cooked into grilled tomatoes at Cooking level 12 or burned at level 27.

name: Kwuarm
note: A bitter green herb obtained through farming, used as a crafting material for potions and poisons.

name: Swamp Weed
note: Harvested from swamp weed plants in the Bloodblight Swamp and used to create swamp thread at a spinning wheel.

name: Snapdragon
note: A sweet-smelling herb used in restorative potions and various potion recipes.

name: Toadflax
note: A spicy-tasting herb harvested from plants in Bloodblight Swamp, used in resistance and skill-boosting potions.

name: Avantoe
note: An herb resource obtained through farming that serves as a potion-making ingredient.

name: Cadavaberries
note: A poisonous food item providing 10 sustenance but 20 Soulscourge damage, cookable at Cooking level 41.

name: Pumpkin
note: A power level 4 cooking ingredient obtainable from plants or farming.

name: Watermelon
note: A consumable food item providing 15 sustenance that can be cooked into watermelon jerky starting at Cooking level 41.

name: Corpse Cotton
note: Drops from a volatile bulbous plant that explodes when hit; can be spun at the spinning wheel to create fine thread.

name: Irit
note: A herb resource harvested from thorny irit roots, used for crafting potions at the brewing cauldron.

name: Desert Weed
note: A material native to the Umbral Sands that can be gathered from plants or farmed, then processed into thread.

name: Cactus Steak
note: A power level 5 raw cooking ingredient that can be cooked into Seared Cactus Steak at a Campfire or Grill.

name: Fibrous Pipe Cactus
note: Found west of the Moon Garou tribe, can be processed into cactus fibres at a tannery.

name: Cactus Water
note: A consumable drink providing 25 hydration and granting the Frosted Flavours perk for scorch resistance.

name: PATTERN: Bloodblight Cape
note: A consumable item that unlocks creation of the Bloodblight cape, found in a chest in Bloodblight Swamp.

name: PATTERN: Bramblemead Cape
note: A consumable pattern item that unlocks the creation of the Bramblemead cape.

name: PATTERN: Fell Cape
note: A blueprint found in Hope's Fall that crafts the Fellhollow Cape at an Armour Bench.

name: PATTERN: Fractured Cape
note: A consumable pattern item that unlocks crafting of the Fractured Cape at an Armour Bench.

name: PATTERN: Stormtouched Cape
note: A consumable item that unlocks creation of the Stormtouched cape, obtained from a chest at Highland Castle's tower.

name: PATTERN: Whispering Cape
note: A consumable pattern item that unlocks creation of the Whispering cape when used at an Armour Bench.

name: Consumable Recipes
note: Consumable recipes are types of blueprints that unlock buildings, weapons, armour, and food, found throughout Ashenfall and dragonkin vaults.

name: Adamant Crossbow Limbs
note: A crafting component made from 2 Adamant Bars at level 40 Artisan, used to create an Adamant Crossbow.

name: Amylase Crystal
note: A crystalline component obtained from Agility course reward packs, used as a reagent in brewing stamina potions.

name: Black Crossbow Limbs
note: Crafting components made from black metal bars at a blacksmith's bench, used to create a shadow crossbow.

name: Blurite Crossbow Limbs
note: Crafted components assembled at a blacksmith's bench using blurite bars, used to create blurite crossbows.

name: Bone Crossbow Limbs
note: A component crafted from 2 Undead Bones at a Blacksmith's Bench requiring Artisan 40, used to create the Dorgeshuun Crossbow.

name: Bronze Crossbow Limbs
note: A pair of bronze crossbow limbs, used in crafting a Bronze Crossbow.

name: Bronze Leaf
note: A craftable component from Agility courses that can be used for potions, construction, or recycled into bronze bars.

name: Clay Decoration
note: A hardened clay figurine component crafted using pottery and kiln, used in construction recipes.

name: Clay Decoration (Unfired)
note: An unfired clay item crafted at a pottery wheel that can be fired in a kiln to create a finished decoration.

name: Clay Mould
note: A fired clay component used at the jeweler's bench to craft enchanted trinkets and amulets.

name: Clay Mould (Unfired)
note: An unfired clay component created by combining three clay on a pottery wheel, fired in a kiln to produce a finished amulet mould.

name: Clay Vessel
note: A component created by firing unfired clay vessels at a kiln with Artisan level 40, used to brew potions at a brewing cauldron.

name: Clay Vessel (Unfired)
note: An unfired clay item created at a pottery wheel requiring level 60 Artisan that can be kiln-fired into a finished clay vessel.

name: Glass Decoration
note: A craftable ornament made from molten glass at a jeweler's bench requiring level 40 Artisan skill.

name: Glass Vessel
note: A glassblown component created from molten glass at a jeweler's bench, used in various potion and weapon recipes.

name: Gold Leaf
note: A craftable component obtained from Agility courses, used to create potions, gilded capes, and jewelry.

name: Iron Crossbow Limbs
note: A pair of iron crossbow limbs, crafted at a blacksmith's bench using 2 iron bars and used in crafting an Iron Crossbow.

name: Mithril Crossbow Limbs
note: A crafted component made from mithril bars at a blacksmith's bench, used to create mithril crossbows.

name: Noxious Draconic Visage
note: A crafting component obtained from the Dragon Slayer quest that upgrades the anti-dragon shield into the dragonblight shield.

name: Silver Leaf
note: A craftable silver component obtainable from Agility courses, used for potion-making or bar recycling.

name: Steel Crossbow Limbs
note: A component crafted from 2 steel bars at a blacksmith's bench requiring level 40 Artisan skill.

name: Clay Slab
note: An item not currently found in the game; its unfired variant also exists in the game cache.

name: Clay Slab (Unfired)
note: An unreleased item discovered in game files, not yet accessible to players.
